text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"El Condor Pasa Accepts Challenge<n>from
Rookie—Match to Be Streamed<n>Live!" ...Man, the
media's all over it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But that aside, you've been having<n>me work on
shortening my stride<n>nonstop. I thought long strides
were<n>better for turf. Are you sure you've<n>got this
the right way around?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: A short stride takes a lot of small,quick steps, which is good foraccelerating, but drains more stamina.Normally, it's recommended for dirt or sprints.
choice_data_list: True, but we're not training for "turf."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For our match with El, we're not<n>using Tracen's
track—I booked the<n>freestyle course instead. The
grass<n>there isn't maintained the way the
academy's turf is, so it'll take a lot<n>more strength
to run on.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm not preparing<n>Nakayama
exclusively for<n>Japanese-style turf, I'm teaching
her<n>skills that will help her run reliably on<n>any
surface, anywhere.
choice_data_list: I'm getting you ready to take on the world.
I'm getting you ready to take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's yet another big claim outta<n>you. But I
guess I'll go try out the<n>short strides on the
freestyle track<n>itself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing like the school tracks<n>here—the turf or
the dirt. Let's go test<n>things out and plan from
there. And<n>then, we raise a storm on the big day.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A "storm" indeed... There ends up<n>being a nasty,
unexpected downpour<n>the night before the race.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Last night's storm passed as quick<n>as it came, so
we're lookin' at bright,<n>sunny skies for our
livestream of El<n>Condor Pasa's race!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...That said, it turns out that hercontestant really is a pre-debutrookie. So much for getting to see El Condor Pasa's full power.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, at least we get to film her at all.<n>Seeing her
obliterate some rookie will<n>show just how crazy
fast she is,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah, they're dissing me without even<n>knowin'
how I run. Sounds like<n>you've got the whole crowd
on your<n>side, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm the condor that's<n>flown 'round the
world. People have<n>high expectations for me, and
you're<n>about to find out why the hard way.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, they're arguing like<n>preschoolers. Who
knows if<n>Nakayama's overconfident or just<n>too
green to know better, but it<n>doesn't matter now.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You'd better not make us watch<n>something as
pathetic as last time.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And the two are off! The ground is a<n>mushy mess
from the storm, but that<n>won't stop the world's
Phantom Bird,<n>El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(I see now. A world-class racer's<n>concentration
and acceleration really<n>are different. I don't have a
shot in<n>hell, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is losing speed! Is<n>she unable to
keep up with El Condor<n>Pasa?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'll set the pace then!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Whew, El Condor Pasa is crushing<n>that rookie.
She's already got a<n>massive lead, so she can slow
down<n>and save her energy, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Guess all these Phantom Bird fans<n>have bird brains
themselves. They're<n>not just "slowing down"—take
a look<n>at the track ahead of them.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(...Ack, that ain't good. El's swinging<n>away from
the inner edge of the<n>track. She must've caught
on... The<n>freestyle course isn't like the<n>school's.)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! The inner edge of the<n>third and fourth
turns is completely<n>flooded—but the section ahead
of El<n>Condor Pasa is clear! The champ's<n>got luck on
her side today!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's not "luck" if she's deliberately<n>avoiding the
water. The puddles are<n>so deep, it'd be like trying
to run in a<n>swamp. No one's cutting through that,
which means...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(If I wanna pass El, I've gotta go all<n>the way
around the outer edge. It's<n>that, or the swamp.
Either way, it'll be<n>a big hit to my stamina, so I
should<n>take the safe route...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But I'm not chickening out of a<n>shortcut!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!
choice_data_list: Cut her off from the inside!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Hang on, that rookie's actuallygaining ground in that swamp! It's ashortcut, yeah, but one slip and shecould get hurt bad!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Damn right, it's risky as hell! But<n>that's what
makes it exciting! This is<n>what it's all about! This is
a real race!<n>A real contest! This feeling—)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: This! THIS IS WHAT I LIVE FOOOR!

text_block_list.name: El & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: HAAAAH! AAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The world-class El Condor Pasa<n>swooped across
the track for another<n>flawless victory! No one
deserves<n>that world tour more than her!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't this nice, El? The masses<n>are celebrating
your big return to<n>racing. You clutched out a second
chance at the global stage.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Wow, Sirius, way to rubit in. But you're right. Bein' out ofpractice is no excuse for almostgettin' upstaged by Nakayama. Apre-debut rookie! A newcomer. Aliteral amateur.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If I get all smug over this win, she's<n>definitely
outflyin' me next time. But I<n>won't let that happen.
The next<n>match, the whole world—it's all mine!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, really? Are those the words of<n>someone who
was just whining<n>about finding a successor at her
press conference? Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama's gonna regret not<n>finishing that bird off
when she had<n>the chance. You'd better sharpen
your claws if you want any shot at<n>the Arc. The rest
of the world's not<n>gonna sit around.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Man, El Condor Pasa really is the<n>champion! That
other runner was just<n>running her mouth after all. I
mean, at<n>least the hype was fun, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'd say that rookie's worth<n>keeping tabs on.
Cinderella stories<n>are everywhere, but some
readers<n>just wanna watch the boy who cried<n>wolf
crash and burn.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Haaah. I blew it big time.<n>Haven't even
debuted yet, and my<n>career's already shot.
choice_data_list:
You still got everyone's attention. Now's the time
to lock in.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Fair enough. Those reporters<n>have got me
marked now. If I bomb<n>my next race, the tabloids
are gonna<n>rip me to shreds. Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's gotta be something wrong<n>with me. I feel
like crap... but I feel so<n>alive! This wasn't some
kiddie sports<n>match. My pulse is screaming for
another hit of adrenaline!
choice_data_list: Wanna designate me as your official trainer then?
Wanna designate me as your official trainer then?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what, you need a formal<n>write-up to call us a
team? You and<n>me already jumped off the deep
end<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So do it. Tell Tracen you're mine. And<n>then...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Train me for more races that'll make<n>me feel alive.
